dataset: Kruger NP Experimental Burn Plot fire database (dated, per-plot)
who_to_ask: SANParks Scientific Services - Navashni Govender (fire ecologist); co-authors S. Higgins (Univ. Bayreuth) / S. Ongole
contact_route: SANParks Scientific Services, Skukuza; corresponding author of Ongole et al. 2026
what_exists: ~1,600+ EBP and landscape burns with grass fuel moisture, fuel load, ROS, intensity since the 1980s (Govender et al. 2006 used 956 burns); the open Zenodo copy lacks burn dates, plot/string IDs and coordinates
why_it_matters: Largest grass-fuel-moisture-at-ignition record from southern African savanna; dates + string coordinates would turn 1,589 undated rows into weather-joinable training labels for the Zimbabwe estate
license_status: Zenodo subset CC-BY-4.0; full database SANParks (ask for commercial-use terms)

dataset: Gwayi State Forest experimental fires (Gambiza et al. 2005)
who_to_ask: James Gambiza (Rhodes University, Environmental Science); Forestry Commission of Zimbabwe
contact_route: Rhodes University; Forestry Commission Zimbabwe research division
what_exists: 15 early-dry-season fires with grass fuel load, fuel moisture, RH, wind, ROS, intensity, scorch height in Baikiaea plurijuga woodland on Kalahari sands (western Zimbabwe)
why_it_matters: Only Zimbabwe field fuel-moisture/fire-behaviour data found; same country and Kalahari-sand savanna/grass fuels as the pilot. Also the PDF hosts were down - ask for the paper PDF/table
license_status: Paper reportedly CC-BY-4.0 via CIFOR; raw data unknown

dataset: Marondera / Matopos long-term fire trials and Hwange/Sengwa fire records
who_to_ask: Zimbabwe Department of Research & Specialist Services (Grasslands Research Station, Marondera; Matopos Research Institute); Zimbabwe Parks & Wildlife Management Authority
what_exists: Long-term fire-trial records since 1950s (fuel load, possibly fuel moisture/curing) per Furley et al. 2008
why_it_matters: In-country grass fuel data; possibly the only multi-decade Zimbabwe record

dataset: Serengeti grass fuel moisture and weather (Gomes et al. 2026)
who_to_ask: Ricardo Holdo / Gomes (Univ. of Georgia / Duke); Duke Research Data Repository curators
contact_route: Duke RDR (datamanagement@duke.edu) for a direct file link; or a manual browser download
what_exists: Field grass fuel moisture + biomass across the Serengeti rainfall gradient, weather-station data (339 MB, CC0)
why_it_matters: East African savanna grass moisture time series across a rainfall gradient - close analogue for Zimbabwe grass curing dynamics
license_status: CC0-1.0 (no permission needed; access only blocked by bot protection)

dataset: Kruger fire-spread limits (Cardoso et al. 2022 PNAS)
who_to_ask: Carla Staver (Yale) / Anabelle Cardoso; or simply a Dryad API token holder
contact_route: Free Dryad API account (token) or browser download
what_exists: 1,131 individual Kruger fires with grass biomass and fuel moisture; 533 VCA plots; fine-scale wind
why_it_matters: Second large Kruger grass-fire dataset; complements kruger_ebp_topkill

dataset: Lamto savanna fire experiment raw plot data (N'Dri et al. 2018)
who_to_ask: Jacques Gignoux (CNRS / iEES Paris); Aya Brigitte N'Dri (Univ. Nangui Abrogoua)
what_exists: 36 plot fires (2013-2017) x 10 quadrats: fresh fuel load, fuel moisture, grass height, weather, ROS, intensity
why_it_matters: Seasonal (early/mid/late) grass fuel moisture at burn in a humid savanna; only box plots published

dataset: Zambia Western Province seasonal burns (Hoffa et al. 1999)
who_to_ask: USFS Rocky Mountain Research Station Missoula Fire Sciences Lab (Wei Min Hao)
what_exists: 13-14 burns Jun-Aug 1996 with repeated green-grass moisture (dambo 127->69%, miombo 119->33%) and fuel loads
why_it_matters: Miombo/dambo seasonal curing-moisture trajectory directly analogous to Zimbabwe miombo and vlei grasslands
license_status: paper AGU copyright (free to read); data unpublished

dataset: Kruger Pretoriuskop curing-grass fuel moisture (Wadehra, SANParks SSN 2024 poster)
who_to_ask: R. Wadehra (Yale) via SANParks Scientific Services
what_exists: Inside vs outside (grazing) fuel moisture in curing grasses, c. 2023-2024
why_it_matters: Recent dated grass curing/moisture series in sourveld similar to Zimbabwe highveld grass

dataset: KwaZulu-Natal grassland curing / fuel moisture series (McGranahan et al. 2016; WF19193)
who_to_ask: Devan McGranahan (USDA-ARS) / Michelle Tedder, Kevin Kirkman (UKZN)
what_exists: Seasonal multi-species grass fuel moisture and curing at 2 mesic grassland sites
why_it_matters: Southern African grass curing ground truth; values only in figures

dataset: Fynbos LFMC (George, Western Cape) and Kraaij thicket/fynbos LFMC
contact_route: Corresponding author of the 2025/26 T&F fynbos LFMC paper (figshare 30892766)
what_exists: ~400 live fuel moisture samples 2017-2018 (3 guilds, 21 months)
why_it_matters: African live-fuel moisture; low direct relevance to savanna grass but adds African LFMC
license_status: supplement CC-BY-4.0 (no values); data by request

dataset: Burkina Faso Tiogo/Laba early-fire experiment (Savadogo et al. 2007)
who_to_ask: Patrice Savadogo (formerly SLU/CIFOR) / INERA Burkina Faso
what_exists: 32 early prescribed fires with grass fuel load and moisture vs fire behaviour
why_it_matters: Sudanian savanna grass fires; paper paywalled

dataset: AMMA-CATCH Gourma herbaceous green/dry mass (Mali, Niger, Benin)
who_to_ask: AMMA-CATCH data office (IRD) - P. Hiernaux / E. Mougin
contact_route: Free registration at bd.amma-catch.org + data policy acceptance (needs user decision: account creation)
what_exists: Monthly wet-season green vs dry herbaceous mass since 1984/2005 (-> curing %)
why_it_matters: Long Sahel grass curing record for curing-model training
license_status: CC-BY-4.0 + AMMA-CATCH policy (co-authorship to be offered)

dataset: 1986 Annaburroo experimental grassland fires full dataset (WF23100)
who_to_ask: CSIRO Bushfire Behaviour & Risks (Andrew Sullivan / Miguel Cruz); CSIRO Publishing permissions
what_exists: ~170 tropical-grassland burn blocks with dead grass moisture, curing, load, weather, ROS
why_it_matters: Canonical cured-grass fire dataset; tropical grass fuels like the Zimbabwe pilot

dataset: SAFARI-2000 burn experiments (ORNL DAAC 752) and LBA-ECO fuel sticks (ORNL 1232)
who_to_ask: No request needed - a free NASA Earthdata account
contact_route: urs.earthdata.nasa.gov (user to create account and supply credentials)
what_exists: Etosha/Kruger/Zambia/Malawi burn data (fuel moisture unverified); Brazil fuel-stick series
why_it_matters: Southern African 2000 dry-season burns incl. Zambia

dataset: Cumberland Plain (AU-Cum) full CS505 half-hourly fuel-moisture record
who_to_ask: Western Sydney University Hawkesbury Institute (Matthias Boer / Rachael Nolan; OzFlux site PI)
what_exists: Continuous CS505 10-h fuel moisture since ~2012 (only 2013 daily minima published)
why_it_matters: Long sensor series for dead-fuel moisture model calibration (non-African)
license_status: OzFlux data CC-BY-4.0 but fuel moisture variable not released
